name: Japandi
oneLiner: Japanese restraint meets Scandinavian warmth: paper tones, honest materials, low contrast, and space used as a feature.

effects.noise: 3% paper fibre texture on the page background only
effects.material: no gloss, no metallic finishes; warmth comes from paper and clay tones

motion.reducedMotion: fade only; no parallax and no staggered reveals

primary.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-family: 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em

link.base: height: 40px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 0

default.base: padding: 32px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border)

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em
default.label: display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

default.base: padding-left: 24px; border-left: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-family: 'Shippori Mincho', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--uiux-color-text)
default.attribution: display: block; margin-top: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

do: Leave 80–120px between sections; emptiness is the composition, not wasted space.
Keep corners at 0–8px and shadows nearly absent; use a 1px rule to separate content instead.
Use one display mincho/serif and one humanist sans with wide line-height (1.8+).
Choose muted, earthy accents — sage, clay, walnut — never pure black or vivid hue.
dont: Do not use pure black text or pure white background; both break the paper feel.
Do not add glossy effects, glass, or neon.
Do not tighten line-height to fit more content; drop content instead.
Do not use more than two accent tones on one page.
antiPatterns: Beige minimalism with four competing accent colors and a 1200-character paragraph.
Japandi styling on a card layout with 12px type and heavy shadows.
Overuse of the 'zen' cliché: cherry blossoms, brush strokes, and fake calligraphy behind real content.

notes: Warm low-contrast palettes tempt 3:1 body text; every pair here is verified at 4.5:1 minimum.
Wide letter-spacing helps CJK and Latin labels but hurts long paragraphs; keep it to labels only.
Long 1.85 line-height increases scroll length; ensure anchor and focus jumps remain visible.
